title: On the loss landscape of the linear neural network: beyond critical points
abstract: arXiv:2611.26671v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While the critical points of the loss landscape in linear neural networks have been extensively studied since the seminal work of Baldi \& Hornik in the late 1980s, a description of this landscape at an intermediate or global scale is still lacking. Such a characterization is crucial, particularly as a substantial body of literature indicates that gradient descent circumvents critical points. The present article introduces an intermediate structure, termed the critical thalweg, which encompasses all critical points and exhibits key geometric properties. Beyond providing a geometric proof of Baldi \& Hornik's results using simpler assumptions than the existing literature, this framework offers a global view of the loss landscape that can be easily visualized in a two-dimensional plane. Empirical observations suggest that gradient descent is attracted toward the critical thalweg, along which the loss continues to decrease to its global m

translated_title: 关于线性神经网络的损失景观：超越临界点
translated_abstract: 自Baldi和Hornik在20世纪80年代末的开创性工作以来，线性神经网络损失景观中的临界点已被广泛研究，但在中间尺度或全局尺度上对这一景观的描述仍然缺失。这种表征至关重要，尤其是因为大量文献表明梯度下降会绕过临界点。本文引入了一种中间结构，称为临界谷线，它包含所有临界点并展现出关键的几何性质。除了在比现有文献更简单的假设下为Baldi和Hornik的结果提供了几何证明之外，该框架还提供了损失景观的全局视角，并且可以在二维平面上轻松可视化。经验观察表明，梯度下降会被吸引向临界谷线，沿着该谷线，损失持续下降直至其全局最小值。
tldr: 本文提出了一种包含线性神经网络损失景观中所有临界点的中间几何结构——“临界谷线”，它提供了可二维可视化的损失景观全局描述，并表明梯度下降会被该结构吸引从而沿其持续降低损失至全局最小值。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "critical thalweg," an intermediate geometric structure encompassing all critical points of the linear neural network loss landscape, offering a globally visualizable description and empirical evidence that gradient descent is attracted toward this structure along which the loss decreases to its global minimum.
